decision_rationale: Core library (predicate engine, contract types, state machine, receipt data model) is well-implemented with 63 passing unit tests and clean CI gates. However, no real action executor exists, no real HTTP observer makes live calls, no receipt persists across invocations, and CLI verify/serve are stubs. Not a runnable service or integrable product.

commands_executed.description: Strict Clippy with warnings as errors
CLI validate invalid contract (empty action name)
CLI validate invalid contract (empty all predicate)
CLI validate contract with postcondition that will fail at runtime
commands_executed.result: PASS (contract parses as valid; postcondition failure is runtime evaluation, not validation)

crate_status.notes: Core types: Action, Contract, Predicate, Observation, Evidence, Receipt, StateMachine, VerificationResult. Schema version. All types are deterministic with no network dependencies.
JSON/YAML parsing, file loading, semantic validation. 7 unit tests.

Predicate engine with all operators: exists, not-exists, equals, not-equals, contains, matches (regex), greater-than, less-than, count, is-empty, is-not-empty, all, any, not, implies, $args resolution. 24 unit tests.

Executor::execute() simulates execution with hardcoded State::Unknown advance. execute_with_executor() requires Arc<dyn ActionExecutor> but no concrete implementations exist in workspace. 6 tests use MockExecutor with predefined DispatchOutcome values. No real I/O.

Ed25519 signing via SigningService. Keys generated in-memory per process. No persistent key storage. Receipt can only be verified in the same process that signed it. 3 tests pass with same key instance.

RestObserver::build_url() validates URLs against injection patterns. observe() method calls fetch_json() but no tests make actual HTTP calls. No testcontainers or mock servers. 11 tests cover URL construction, redaction, truncation only.
contract validate works correctly (load, parse, validate, JSON/text output, stable exit codes). verify and serve are stubs (print message only). 0 unit tests.

limitations: No real ActionExecutor implementations (no REST client, database driver, message queue integration)
No live HTTP calls in tests (RestObserver observe() never reaches reqwest in test suite)
No persistent ReceiptStore (receipts not durable across process restarts)
No key management (SigningService generates ephemeral keys, no KMS, no rotation, no certificate chain)
No integration tests (0 testcontainers, 0 external service mocks, 0 failure injection)
CLI verify and serve commands are stubs (primary user-facing commands unimplemented)
cargo audit not installed (dependency vulnerability scanning not performed)
No proptest property tests (proptest in dependencies but unused)
HTTP observer security: no redirect, IPv6, credentials-in-URL, HTTP desync, or response-timing tests

recommendation: Do not integrate into Control Center or any production service at this time. The core library is sound and suitable for further development. Focus next efforts on: (1) real ActionExecutor implementation for at least one transport, (2) testcontainers-based HTTP observer tests, (3) persistent ReceiptStore with cross-process verification.
